facts.F1_leak: amount_approved is set after the claim (≈0.85-0.97 × claim_cost) → must be flagged and excluded
facts.F3_group_split: member_id repeats (members file several claims) → group split
facts.F5_log_target: claim_cost is heavy-tailed (log-normal) → log target should help
facts.F6_interaction: age matters strongly only for smoker=yes (slope 0.045 vs 0.010 on log scale)
facts.F7_engineered: BMI = weight/height² drives cost; a weight/height ratio should help vs raw columns
facts.F8_noise: policy_suffix, signup_channel, region and annual_income carry no signal
facts.F9_informative_missing: prior_claims_count is missing more often for high-cost claims
facts.N1_fairness_negative: sex has NO effect → fairness on sex should be 'not material' (false-alarm check)
facts.N2_time_negative: no trend over claim_date → time check should say stable (false-alarm check)
